profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | Scaling AI-Driven Solutions across iCode, RevolutionEd & Managed Staffing

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead Software Engineer at iCode Corporate, specializing in building and scaling new initiatives. Currently spearheading the technical execution and development of a major new corporate program rollout. I bridge the gap between high-level vision and hands-on execution, driving the core codebase and managing the full launch lifecycle.

positions.title: Sales Generalist
positions.description:
Enhanced customer engagement through tailored product recommendations, resulting in noticeable increases in sales
conversions.
Additionally spearheaded development of an internal tool used by employees to access daily top Member Deals, increasing
attach rates and customer satisfaction by 46%.
Cross-trained and flexed across multiple departments including Sales, Geek Squad, Front of Store, and Warehouse,
demonstrating adaptability, strong customer service, and operational support skills.

positions.title: Delivery Driver
positions.description:
Safely and efficiently delivered packages to residential and commercial locations, ensuring timely arrival
Demonstrated excellent customer service skills, resolving any delivery issues promptly and professionally
positions.insights: Skills: Commercial Packages · Customer Service · Service Delivery

positions.title: Service Technician Assistant
positions.description:
Assisted in installing, repairing, and maintaining Industrial Bandsaws and equipment under the guidance of senior technicians
Conducted routine inspections and troubleshooting to identify mechanical issues and recommend appropriate solutions
Managed inventory of parts and tools, ensuring availability for service calls and projects
positions.insights: Skills: Equipment Installation · Electrical Troubleshooting · Inventory Management

positions.title: Lead Instructor
positions.description:
Oversaw and managed a team of instructors to ensure consistency in teaching methods and curriculum delivery
Developed and implemented training programs to enhance instructional skills and support professional development among instructors
positions.insights: Skills: Team Management · Teaching · Programming Languages
